item.title: Upgrade 8 to 9 on HP DL360 G7
item.author: invalid@example.com (stra4d)
item.dc:creator: stra4d
item.content:encoded:
Just an FYI. If anyone is contemplating or nervous about upgrading (in place 8 to 9) on their older HP DL360 G7 units, I have done 3 of them and they all seem to be running fine (ours have the RAID Smart Array P410i).

There was a warning from the pve8to9 script about intel-microcode, which I installed. Not sure if that was required or not but I did install. After the VMs were shut down there were zero warnings. Everything upgrade fine, back up and running no issues.

item.title: communication issue between SRIOV VM VF and CT on PF bridge
item.author: invalid@example.com (ctr)
item.dc:creator: ctr
item.content:encoded:
I'm passing through a VF using SRIOV to a VM. This VM works fine, I can reach it from Proxmox (mgmt interface on vmbr0 of the PF) and other hosts on the network.
However, a CT attached to the very same vmbr0 cannot reach the VM, but also everything else on the network. According to tcpdump packets from the CT are getting to the VF and the VF is responding, but those response packets are then not visible on the PF anymore and as result do not reach the CT.

Does that ring any bells?
